svg.title: Contour event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture diagram for Contour: Kubernetes informers produce resource-change events, EventHandler consumes them, rebuilds the DAG, and notifies xDS caches which push Envoy config snapshots.

sendPrompt('Why does Contour use a holdoff timer before rebuilding the DAG?')
sendPrompt('How does builder.Build() construct the DAG?')

g.text: xDS caches — react to DAG change
